settings
{
	main
	{
		Mode Name: "Custom Settings"
		Description: "Shows settings, workshop settings and translations"
	}
	lobby
	{
		Max Team 1 Players: 4
		Max Team 2 Players: 0
	}
	modes
	{
		Team Deathmatch
		{
			enabled maps
			{
				Workshop Chamber
				Workshop Island
			}
		}
	}
	heroes
	{
		General
		{
			Reaper
			{
				Wraith Form Cooldown Time: 50%
			}
			disabled heroes
			{
				Bastion
			}
		}
	}
	extensions
	{
		Beam Effects
	}
}

variables {
    global:
        127: __overpyTranslationHelper__
}

rule ("Initialize global variables") {
    event {
        Ongoing - Global;
    }
    actions {
        Set Global Variable(__overpyTranslationHelper__, String Split(Custom String("0White0Blanc"), First Of(Null)));
    }
}

rule ("Round banner") {
    event {
        Ongoing - Global;
    }
    actions {
        Create HUD Text(All Players(All Teams), Value In Array(String Split(Custom String("ＴＬＥｒｒRound {0} of {1}Manche {0} sur {1}", Match Round, Workshop Setting Integer(Custom String("Gameplay"), Custom String("Rounds"), 5, 1, 20, 0)), Global.__overpyTranslationHelper__), Absolute Value(Index Of Array Value(Global.__overpyTranslationHelper__, String Split(Color(White), Empty Array)))), Null, Null, Left, 0, Color(White), Null, Null, Visible To Sort Order String and Color, Default Visibility);
    }
}

rule ("Hard mode") {
    event {
        Ongoing - Each Player;
        All;
        All;
    }
    conditions {
        Workshop Setting Toggle(Custom String("Gameplay"), Custom String("Hard mode"), False, 0) == True;
        Workshop Setting Combo(Custom String("Gameplay"), Custom String("Difficulty"), 1, Array(Custom String("Easy"), Custom String("Normal"), Custom String("Hard")), 0) >= 2;
    }
    actions {
        Create HUD Text(Event Player, Null, Value In Array(String Split(Custom String("ＴＬＥｒｒHard mode is onLe mode difficile est activé"), Global.__overpyTranslationHelper__), Absolute Value(Index Of Array Value(Global.__overpyTranslationHelper__, String Split(Color(White), Empty Array)))), Null, Left, 0, Null, Color(White), Null, Visible To Sort Order String and Color, Default Visibility);
        Set Max Health(Event Player, 150);
    }
}
